author: MajestysDream
body:
Recently I have been playing a lot of Nebula. One thing I have found is that the Nebula Shop has useless items. The Shop consists of 10 apples, 5 cooked steak, 5 mushroom stews, 64 arrows, Potion of Swiftness, Potion of Fire Resistance, Splash potion of Swiftness, Splash potion of Fire resistance, Music disc (C418- chirp,) broken music disc (C418-11,) jukebox, flaming torch, 16 snowballs, and of course, the Spanky Spade. Now, I have realized some problems. You can buy steak, apples, or mushroom stews. I honestly think that mushroom stews or steak should be taken out because you honestly do not need that much food in the shop. However, the apples should remain to stay. The 64 arrows are okay. The potions are okay. Now, one of my main problems are the music discs and the jukebox. Now, I understand that those items are fun to have in the shop, but they are useless. Like, really.  The flaming torch is nice, I like it, very creative! Also, another big problem, the snowballs. Now, honestly, who in this damn world would need snowballs? That needs to be taken out. Finally, the Spanky Spade. I am fine with this, though the price should drop a bit as well as the level you need to get to obtain a Spanky Spade. Another problem is that the prices are too damn high. Also, another topic talked about throughout the whole server, are the grenades. I believe that they should be added back, though for all people, but for a lot more points as well as a higher level to obtain grenades. I hope my feedback can really help and I hope some of you can agree. Thanks! 


                                    -CrafterPete1013

replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: Regular apples should be removed from the shop, as from any map that has them. God apples are entirely overpowered, not to mention the amount of accusations of "regeneration hacks" they bring around. I don't mind having other food in there- I can't find a reason why not. As for grenades, if you're going to add them back, make thm accessible to everyone. However, I don't think they should be added back at all. They're impractical and quite overpowered. If they were to be added back, they should be quite expensive (30-50 points for 5 grenades, persay).
